content: gray-matter v4.0.3 (current npm, last major release; low recent commit velocity) is designed for Node.js file-parsing use cases (build scripts, SSGs like Eleventy/Metalsmith) and is not verified browser/Vite-bundle safe (see Buffer issue above). front-matter v4.0.2 is a lighter alternative but shares similar Node-oriented design assumptions and is not confirmed browser-safe either. Recommendation for this project: avoid both in client-bundled code; use js-yaml (pure JS, browser-safe) plus a two-line regex split on the '---' delimiters instead.
